contracts.entry: Enter only after an actual selected Hybrid Archetype spin, commit and reaction. Preserve initial Race gate decision and parent source. Main Race Hybrid never invokes this role by name alone.
contracts.order: Primary Hybrid reaction -> child one actual selection/commit/reaction -> its complete immediate event chain -> child two selection/commit/reaction -> its complete immediate event chain -> Hybrid completion -> Backstory.
contracts.pool: Reuse approved canonical role definitions and explicit body compatibility, including NPC. Apply current roster removals, disable Hybrid and already-used child IDs before sampling. No selected-then-rerolled duplicate or silently substituted result. Apply pairCompatibility static exclusions before sampling child2.
contracts.probability: Reuse current canonical main-wheel-strength per-sector weights after roster/body/self/used-child guards, then normalize/freeze. Active Equalizer from child one replaces future final weights with1; no band rebalance after exclusions. No child event odds changed.
contracts.history: Use local Hybrid usedChildArchetypeIds, initialized with Hybrid. Commit child one before dispatching its event; exclude it from child two. Do not read/write usedRaceFamilyIds, mentor/army/prey history or past-character Archetypes for these draws.
contracts.minimumPool: Require an approved compatible two-role schedule. Fewer than two eligible distinct children, missing compatibility/policy data, or a second-child pool made invalid by the first event requires configuration. Retain committed outcomes; do not reset history, reroll child one, invent None or silently finish with one child.
contracts.events: Each selected child executes its existing approved event definition once, including only that event’s declared child spins and deferred tickets. NPC occupies one child and has no follow-up. Hybrid adds no intrinsic power, weapon, stat, mastery, army, weakness or count/type selector.
contracts.return: Pass a saved caller frame to each child. Its logical Backstory return resumes the Hybrid frame instead of advancing the global stage. Nested race/power/weapon events restore their own caller first; after both children fully return, advance to Backstory once.
contracts.identity: Retain Hybrid as the source wrapper and record two distinct owned child Archetype records. This adds roles, not races. No Race Hybrid event, no giant second-slot revival, no extra primary gate and no automatic body/Size change.
contracts.mutation: Mutant selected as a child may acquire its normal extra race. Its return resumes Hybrid. Keep the initial gate snapshot frozen; the later second child is authorized by Hybrid, not a Mutant re-entry. Current body/equipment composition needs an explicit compatible profile before any dependent role selection.
contracts.rewards: Apply each child’s source-owned recipe once. Keep fixed gifts and distinct numeric modifiers with provenance; calculate bonuses at final bonus phase. Normal inventory/None retention, one shared Power Mastery, per-weapon mastery and compatible final Enchant remain. Duplicate definitions follow existing canonical inventory policy, not automatic rerolls.
contracts.locks: Avoid conflicting partner recipes with the pair filter before selection. Gladiator normal lock still applies to earlier race weapons; Hybrid grants no compensation or bypass.
contracts.policyComposition: Distinct roles may coexist through this explicitly approved wrapper. Preserve each role’s exact triggers, counts, guarantees, raw-result observers and modifier scope. Do not double normal stages/mastery, activate every Gambler type, stack duplicate Resilient retries or invent an order for incompatible policies. An approved compatible schedule is required where existing contracts leave combination unspecified.
contracts.context: Every actual primary/child/event spin receives its own reaction using only committed facts. After child one, child two is still unknown. Wrapper captions/fixed grants are not actual extra spins or funny-result tags.
contracts.ledger: Atomically commit each selected child and local exclusion history before scheduling its event. Freeze source/version/pool/odds/body/policy references, ordinal, chosen ID, child completion and exact saved caller. Resume/re-render reuses committed records, schedules only unfinished work and grants no reward twice.
contracts.migration: Use this design for new invocations. Preserve older source-only Hybrid records and frozen runs; do not execute the new event merely by reading or rendering historical labels.

compatibleSchedules.schedule: For each applicable main-stat raw roll, perform required Resilient retry and keep higher raw first; then apply Gambler Double/Nothing once if that subtype is active. All In has one Strength raw procedure then raw copies; High Roller chooses its four normal0..9 extremes before hard guarantees; Lucky Number observes each actual raw attempt, never copy/projection.
Gambler structural eligible-value/copy/multiplier policies remain. Equalizer makes each remaining hard-eligible actual wheel uniform; it does not create skipped rolls or restore hard-excluded values.

pairCompatibility.selection: Before first draw remove children without any compatible partner in the body-eligible pool. Before child2 exclude self/Hybrid and matrix partners of child1, then canonical weights/modifiers/normalization. Preserve committed child1 and never redraw to get a better child2.
pairCompatibility.futureOutcomes: Static exclusions consider the partner possible authorized branches without reading future results; never silently cancel a required reward after selection.
